en.bdb: Within the teaching of the Guru, the Sikhs of the Guru serve (others).
They give in charity the four riches (char padarathi) to the beggars.
They sing paeans of the invisible Lord who is beyond all accounts.

verses.gurmukhi: ਭਾਇ ਭਗਤਿ ਰਸ ਇਖ ਅਮਿਉ ਚੁਆਵਣੀ।
verses.translit_en: bhai bhagat ras ikh amiau chuaavanee|

en.bdb: They drink the juice of the sugarcane of loving devotion, and make others also enjoy the same.

verses.gurmukhi: ਤੁਲਿ ਨ ਭੂਤ ਭਵਿਖ ਨ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਪਾਵਣੀ।
verses.translit_en: tul na bhoot bhavikh na keemat paavanee|

en.bdb: Nothing in the past as well as the future can be equal to their love.

verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਮਾਰਗ ਵਿਖ ਲਵੈ ਨ ਲਾਵਣੀ ॥੧੭॥
verses.translit_en: gurmukh maarag vikh lavai na laavanee ||17||

en.bdb: None can vie with even the one step of the way of gurmukhs.
